Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Task 319794d9: extend a full-line shadow past an adjacent object

## Validated rule
The input contains a complete straight line of color 2 and a separate colored shape immediately adjacent to one side of that line. Keep both the line and the shape exactly where they are. Add a complete parallel line of color 8 immediately beyond the shape's far edge, on the side away from the color-2 line. The new color-8 line spans the entire grid dimension parallel to the original line (not merely the object's size/cross-section). Preserve all other cells.

- For a vertical color-2 line, identify the adjacent object's farthest column away from the line; put color 8 in the next column, from top to bottom.
- For a horizontal color-2 line, identify the adjacent object's farthest row away from the line; put color 8 in the next row, across the full width.
- Shape may occupy only part of the dimension parallel to the full line. The output stripe nevertheless covers the full dimension.
- Do not move the object. This is distinct from object-motion/trail tasks.

## Demonstration evidence
1. 27x14 grid: full vertical 2-line at column 5 (0-based); a color-1 rectangle at column 4, rows 10–18. Output added a full-height color-8 line at column 3; line and rectangle stayed fixed.
2. 23x22 grid: full horizontal 2-line at row 20; a color-7 irregular shape occupies rows 14–19 and touches the line. Output added a full-width color-8 line at row 13; the color-7 shape and 2-line stayed fixed.
3. Solved test: 10x19 grid with vertical 2-line at column 1 and a small color-7 L shape at rows 6–7, columns 2–3. Correct output was a full-height color-8 line at column 4; all input cells remained unchanged otherwise.

4. 25x27 grid: full vertical 2-line at column 26; a color-5 shape occupies rows 16–17, columns 23–25, touching the line at column 25. Correct output adds a full-height color-8 line at column 22, immediately beyond the shape's far edge; all input cells remain unchanged.
5. Confirmed on a 17x11 test: full vertical 2-line at column 9; a 1-shape at rows 2–7, columns 7–8. Correct output adds a full-height 8-line at column 6; the input line and shape remain unchanged.

## Additional confirmed solved instance and caution
A 16x7 test had a full horizontal color-2 row at row 3 (0-based), and a separate three-cell horizontal color-4 object at row 9, columns 2-4. The correct output preserved the input and added a full-width color-8 row at row 5 (0-based), two rows below the color-2 line; it did NOT place the 8 stripe beyond the object's far edge. This is inconsistent with a simple universal rule that always puts the stripe immediately past the object's far edge. The task's demonstrated cases may have additional selection/placement structure; after an incorrect submission, do not keep applying the far-edge rule mechanically. Recompare the exact full-line/object geometry and, if needed, request a discriminating demo before another attempt.

## Validation checklist
- Confirm color 2 forms a complete row or column.
- Identify the separate object and its relation to the full line; do not assume it touches the line.
- Infer the stripe's exact location from all available examples. Prior examples often add a full-length color-8 stripe beyond the object's far edge, but the confirmed 16x7 case instead puts it at row 5, two rows below the full line.
- Extend the stripe across the entire dimension parallel to the full line.
- Preserve the input object and full color-2 line; preserve every other cell unless evidence establishes overwriting.
- Ensure output dimensions match input.
